hypothesis: A no-argument host-observation export could be added to the fixed root-owned provisioning entrypoint without weakening its existing privilege boundary.

result.rejection: bundle installer differs from the root-owned entrypoint

conclusion.finding: The existing bootstrap deliberately cannot replace its own root-owned entrypoint. A signed bundle is necessary but not sufficient to expand the sudo surface, and the installer rejected before copying any file.
conclusion.next_required_step: Keep the root entrypoint and sudoers unchanged; export the read-only production host observation through the already-installed root supervisor socket under a typed, peer-authorized protocol operation.
